name: Off Pako Choukyou Haishin ~Hameochi-hime wa Osu no Aji o Wasurenai~
original_name: オフパコ調教配信～ハメ堕ち姫は牡の味を忘れられない～
source: The story revolves around Hikawa Ai, the daughter of renowned fashion designer parents, who lives a somewhat isolated life due to her parents' absence. Despite professional success, she feels the void of not having a romantic partner. To enhance her fashion designing skills and address her lack of physical activity, she starts sharing dance videos and casual chats on a web channel. Responding to interest from her viewers, she plans a meetup after turning 20. However, the meetup takes an unexpected turn as Ai tries alcohol for the first time, leading to intimate encounters with a group of four participants. This experience brings about a significant transformation in her daily life.
translation: 故事围绕冰川爱展开。她的父母都是知名服装设计师，却因长期不在身边，让她过着有些孤独的生活。尽管事业顺利，没有恋人相伴仍让她感到空虚。为了提升服装设计能力，并改善运动不足的问题，她开始在网络频道分享舞蹈视频，与观众闲聊。回应观众们的期待，她计划在满20岁后举办线下见面会。然而，初次饮酒的爱与四名参与者发生了亲密关系，让这场聚会走向意料之外，也令她的日常生活产生了重大变化。
